title: Basic SELECTS [Syntax]
description:
In sql, eveything lives on somthing called _tables_. Tables are just where data is stored. Don't worry, I won't be shoving creating full tables on you this early. This lesson, we will cover _actually **getting**_ the data from tables.
In SQL, you get data from tables with somthing called a `SELECT` statement. SELECTs have the following syntax; 
```sql
SELECT rows FROM tablename;
```
For now, we will be doing somthing called _wildcard SELECTs_. This just selects all rows. Wildcard selects replace rows with the * character. To select eveything from the table "Users", you would `SELECT * FROM Users`
## Assignment:
BWS needs a query to get all our buckets! Write a query to get EVERYTHING from the `buckets` table.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE buckets (name TEXT, type TEXT, size TEXT); INSERT INTO buckets VALUES ('backups', 'directory', '123gb'); INSERT INTO buckets VALUES ('homework', 'files', '144142gb'); INSERT INTO buckets VALUES ('test', 'nothing', '0b'); INSERT INTO buckets VALUES ('BWSdata', 'we need stuff for ourselves, ok?', '400TB');
expectedOutput:
name | type | size
backups | directory | 123gb
homework | files | 144142gb
test | nothing | 0b
BWSdata | we need stuff for ourselves, ok? | 400TB
